name: cursor-quota
description: Shows Cursor plan quota usage in the status bar without opening Settings.

commands.title: Cursor Quota: Open Usage in Settings

cursorQuota.refresh.enabled.description: Automatically refresh quota data from Cursor.

cursorQuota.statusBar.showIncluded.description: Show included quota usage progress in the status bar.

cursorQuota.statusBar.showTotal.description: Show total plan usage percentage in the status bar.

cursorQuota.statusBar.showAccountEmail.description: Append logged-in email (read from local Cursor auth cache) to tooltips.

scripts.package: node scripts/prepare-bin-for-target.mjs $(node -p "process.platform + '-' + process.arch") && vsce package --allow-missing-repository --no-rewrite-relative-links; node scripts/restore-bin.mjs
scripts.package:all: pnpm run package:darwin-arm64 && pnpm run package:darwin-x64 && pnpm run package:linux-x64 && pnpm run package:win32-x64 && pnpm run package:win32-arm64
scripts.package:darwin-arm64: node scripts/prepare-bin-for-target.mjs darwin-arm64 && vsce package --target darwin-arm64 --allow-missing-repository --no-rewrite-relative-links && node scripts/restore-bin.mjs

scripts.package:linux-x64: node scripts/prepare-bin-for-target.mjs linux-x64 && vsce package --target linux-x64 --allow-missing-repository --no-rewrite-relative-links && node scripts/restore-bin.mjs
